Preflight violation prevents measurement; in-run violation stops after the active process and retains partial evidence. No exclusions or automatic retries. host_conditions.limitation: A standard runner is a fresh VM, not proof of a quiet physical host. Sampled process CPU/load and optional /proc/stat steal counters cannot rule out unsampled or hypervisor interference. Claims are platform-specific; steal is observational, not an added acceptance gate.
host_conditions.aggregate_definition: Sum all non-excluded ps CPU percentages divided by the verified four logical CPUs; ps 100% is one logical core. Exactly 20% total external capacity is allowed; >20% is inconclusive.
host_conditions.worker_condition: Dedicated standard public runner job: online dependency fetch and sequential builds finish before measurement; no concurrent WARM worker builds/tests. Observed external compiler/build executables also disqualify the run.
